title: SILENT FAILURE RATE as third north star + calibration/selective-risk tooling
status: GREEN (tooling) / measurement blocked on this box (canonical runs absent)

silentFailureContract.definition: a user-visible confident material claim (target identity, event, stroke L1, contact marker, phase render) that gold says is wrong; abstentions are NOT silent failures; unverifiable claims (no gold stroke label / no gold contact) count as neither
silentFailureContract.note: written from the product definition; change only by re-versioning, never softening in place (usable-result-v1 pattern)

cascadeIntegration.prints: SILENT FAILURES x/n ALL TRIALS and x/m ANSWERED TRIALS alongside strict survival and usable-result-v1, off the same per-case report artifacts; per-claim verdicts per case; persisted in the cascade JSON under silentFailure

cascadeOnThisBox.provenance: MEASURED on this Linux box by running pnpm lab:cascade — canonical run dirs (datasets/paddle-bench/runs/) are gitignored and absent, so the silent-failure code path prints honestly-empty denominators; NOT a cascade measurement
cascadeOnThisBox.codePathVerified: packages/swing-lab/test/silentFailure.test.ts — SYNTHETIC FIXTURE reports (clearly marked) exercise every claim outcome: correct, silent_failure, abstained, unverifiable

coverageRiskCurves.provenance: committed artifacts wave-b/W14-overlap/{ta-overlap,ownership-overlap,agreement}.json — the only committed wave-a/wave-b JSONs pairing per-case confidences with an independent correctness signal; correctness = 3-class agreement with the primary annotator (inter-annotator proxy, NOT gold, NOT model confidence)

taOverlap.keyPoints: risk 0.000 at coverage 0.417 (threshold 0.90); risk 0.167 at full coverage — both disagreements sit at annotator confidence <= 0.85

ownershipOverlap.keyPoints: risk 0.000 through coverage 0.613 (threshold 0.80); risk 0.097 at full coverage — all 3 disagreements at confidence <= 0.75

coverageRiskCurves.caveat: n=12 and n=31 (clustered in 12 frames / 3 videos): curves are exact over these samples, not stable population estimates

gates.tests: pnpm vitest run (swing-lab): 13 files, 164 passed / 4 skipped (pre-existing skips), including new silentFailure.test.ts and calibration.test.ts

honestNegatives: No real silent-failure numbers exist yet: canonical runs are absent on Linux, so SILENT FAILURES prints 0/0 here; the first real measurement requires pnpm lab:regen + lab:cascade on the macOS box.

No committed wave-a/wave-b artifact carries MODEL per-case confidences alongside gold; the coverage-risk curves use annotator self-reported confidence with agreement-with-primary as the correctness proxy. Model-confidence selective-risk curves remain future work once run dirs with selectionConfidence/contact confidence are regenerable here.
CONTACT_MARKER wrongness uses gold-relative error (66/132ms usable-result-v1 conventions); at runtime the product cannot compute this, so silent-failure-v1 is a bench metric, not a runtime gate.

Pre-existing no-console lint errors in other swing-lab CLI files (benchRegen, contactForensics, eventBoundsScout, eventWindowSlice, paddleSelectionForensics, waveaValidate) were left untouched (out of scope); all new files lint clean.
